gist.summary: Added SPOT AI to the games catalog in README.md and the app registry. Built for Pollinations Quest #15725, the browser game asks players to distinguish real images from AI-generated ones using Pollinations image models.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel-art game nook, Polli studies two framed pictures marked with a tiny question mark while pixel flowers grow around a lime green (#ecf874) display. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny detective glasses and stays small within the scene, sharing the frame with the pictures. Strictly pixel art style, never realistic; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with dark purple (#110518) outlines.
